about: Words OpenCC writes in the wrong Traditional character here, for both Taiwan (src/srw64_native/zh_hant.py) and Hong Kong (src/srw64_native/zh_hant_hk.py, which then applies its own character forms). A simplified character with several traditional ones (只 隻, 干 乾/幹, 里 裡, 发 髮, 别 彆, 出 齣, 回 迴, 复 覆) is chosen by OpenCC's phrase table, which sometimes splits a sentence wrongly (总是只能 as 總是隻能, 资料里根本 with 里根 as Reagan) or keeps a transliteration's 里 as 裡. phrases: held after the names and before OpenCC, longest first, the value written as is (names.json "words" win on a clash). guard: held before the names everywhere, for a name the names would otherwise cut into (迪斯盖亚 is not 迪斯 and the Taiwan name of 盖亚). dialogue_guard: held before the names in dialogue lines only, so a game term that is also an everyday word (集中, the spirit command 专注 in Taiwan) stays a word in narration. dialogue_words: Taiwan only, dialogue lines only, s2twp word changes right in the UI but wrong in narration (设置 an installation, 保存 to keep, 支持 to back someone). The measure word 台 (那台, 三台) is written 台, not OpenCC's 臺 (user, 2026-11-28); 臺詞 and 舞臺 keep 臺. フリード星 and キリマンジャロ take Taiwan's 弗瑞德星 and 吉力馬札羅 (user, 2026-11-28).
